info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Management Manual Retrieval API
info.description: The Management Manual Retrieval API allows users to access detailed management manuals that provide essential information and guidelines for banking operations. This endpoint is designed for financial institutions, compliance officers, and auditors who need to consult management protocols and practices. By retrieving specific management manuals using the provided parameter, consumers can ensure they are informed about standard operating procedures and regulations. This API serves as a crucial resource in maintaining regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific management manual identified by its unique ID. This operation allows users to access the content and attributes of the specified management manual to aid in knowledge management and documentation processes.

requestBody.description: The request body for the operation which retrieves the management manual associated with the specified resource identifier. This request expects a JSON formatted payload that describes the parameters or criteria for fetching the resource.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the requested data is returned.

GetManagementManualByIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for the knowledge management manual operations.

GetManagementManualByIdResponse_200.title: Management Manual Response

manualId.description: Unique identifier for the management manual.

version.description: Version number of the management manual.

ownerId.description: Identifier of the owner of the management manual.

effectiveDate.description: The date from which the manual is effective.

classification.description: Classification level of the management manual.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the manual record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the manual was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the management manual.

GetManagementManualByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema containing details about a management manual.
